messages:
maya: CI microbench failed on PR #11811 — kv_prefetch_affinity test regressed ~12% on rtx-pool. Looks like a kernel-selection flip. Blocking rollout until we triage. https://ci.redwood/3456
ci-bot: [ci job] pr-11811/microbench/kv_prefetch_affinity — FAILED
```
baseline: 8.3ms avg
current: 9.3ms avg  (+12.0%)
threshold: 5%
```
sam: :eyes: Any idea what changed in the PR? kernel-selector? batching heuristics?
maya: PR touches runtime/kernel_selector.cc and autoscale/batcher config. Small heuristic tweak: prefer_kv_friendly=true by default now. Commit 3f2a9b7
perf-bot: microbench diffs for kv_prefetch_affinity:
```
Test: kv_prefetch_affinity
Metric: p50_latency_tokens
Baseline: 420
PR: 470 (+11.9%)
Hotspot: kernel_selector::select_kernel() increased time by 9%
Stack sample: increased time in compute_kernel_cost()
```
Aj Patel: can someone run the microbench locally with kernel autoselect off? `--kernel-autoselect=false` — that should tell us if selector change is root cause. I can bisect if repro is easy.
lina: I can repro on my devbox (A10x). Quick `perf stat` shows L2 cache-miss spike during kernel selection path. Snippet:
```
# perf stat -e L2_RQ.MISS -p <pid>
cycles: 123456789
L2_RQ.MISS:  1,234,567  (↑ 40% vs baseline)
```
maya: That matches telemetry: kv_cache_miss_ratio up 34% for the PR's run. If KV misses go up, latency will too. Is this enough to warrant a revert?
sam: If kernel_selector heuristic is causing more unfavorable kernel picks for common seqlen distribution, I'd prefer a targeted revert of the heuristic change rather than whole PR. But if rollout blocked for customers, do revert and patch later.
Aj Patel: starting a quick bisect on CI to find offending commit in the PR branch. Running: `./tools/ci-bisect --job pr-11811 --range 3f2a9b7..HEAD`
perf-bot: bisect finished — narrowest suspect commit: 3f2a9b7 (author: maya) — heuristic toggle `prefer_kv_friendly` introduced. CI run with that commit disabled passes microbench.
maya: ok I will open a revert PR for the heuristic toggle (revert 3f2a9b7) and put the fix behind a feature flag. Creating revert: https://git.redwood/reverts/11811-revert-pref-kv
lina: note for follow-up: kernel cost model needs a KV-weighted penalty term; current cost estimation ignores KV locality for small batch sizes. I can mock a fix and bench.
sam: thanks. assigning rollback approval to @eng-runtime squad. If revert is approved, we can re-run CI + smoke on canary. :thumbsup:
Aj Patel: ack — will monitor the revert CI and re-run blocked rollout job.
maya: thanks all — keeping this as rollout-blocker until revert lands.
